purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Singleton (LawLytics, TriNet Hire). The job page renders the blank application form inline (form#new_applicant, method post). No login, no captcha, no required attributes; the page shows no asterisks either, so required-ness is unknown until server validation.

control_families.text: Rails-style names applicant[first_name|last_name|email|address|city|state|postal|phone|linkedin]; labels via <label for> for most, placeholders (Address/City/State/Postal) for the location sub-fields.
control_families.file: applicant_resumes[resume] ('Resume' / 'Attach resume'), attach_other_files[attach_another_file_1] ('Attach another file' + hidden 'Add another' button), applicant_cover_letters[cover_letter] ('Attach your Cover Letter - or:'); no accept attribute.
control_families.textarea: applicant[cover_letter] 'Cut and Paste your Cover Letter below:'
control_families.linkedin_dialog: hidden bootbox dialog with input name=linkedin 'Linkedin url' and format help 'Should be {http://www.linkedin.com/pub/[member-name/]x/y/z} or {http://www.linkedin.com/in/string}'

field_patterns.label_seen: What is your Linkedin Profile URL?

controls: textarea 'Cut and Paste your Cover Letter below:'

step_patterns.identity_hint: host app.trinethire.com, form#new_applicant, heading 'Apply for this job'

blockers.detail: No auth, no captcha, no required markers observed.

runtime_observations: No required attributes or asterisks: treat name/email/resume as required by convention and expect server-side validation errors after submit (not observed).
Location is split into four inputs identified only by placeholder text.
No employer custom questions on this listing.

inferred.validation_unverified: Which fields are mandatory is unknown; TriNet Hire typically requires name, email and resume.

provider_hint.for_jev: trinethire: single page, Rails-named fields, labels via for/placeholder. fact_copy for name/email/phone/address/linkedin; file for resume/cover letter; the cover-letter textarea is free_text_narrative -> writer. Stop at 'Submit Application'.

edge_cases: Cover letter can be given either as a file or pasted text; do not fill both.
The hidden LinkedIn dialog duplicates the LinkedIn field with a different name (linkedin vs applicant[linkedin]); map only the visible one.
